verdict.rationale: The product is a desktop CPU, a hardware component, so the API-versus-UI parity axis does not apply to it. The evidence describes the companion Ryzen Master tuning utility as a GUI tool, but nothing shows the product exposes any API whose parity with a UI could be judged, so the exception that would make the axis applicable is not triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
